description.value: Market on Yates is a locally owned, family-operated full-service supermarket in downtown Victoria with departments spanning produce, deli, meat and seafood, bakery, and grocery. The in-house bakery is known for specialty cakes, muffins, and artisan breads, while the deli runs a hot case stocked with rotisserie chicken and made-from-scratch meals — a practical refuel stop for cyclists passing through the city core. It is one of two Market Stores locations and positions itself as a genuine community grocery rather than a chain.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at themarketstores.com clearly confirms the Yates location at 903 Yates Street Victoria BC V8V 3M4 with phone (250) 381-6000, matching OSM tags. The site describes a full-service locally owned supermarket with produce, deli, bakery, meat, and a hot case (rotisserie chicken, made-from-scratch meals), confirming basic groceries and hot food. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible supermarket in downtown Victoria with confirmed location, contact details, and a wide range of grocery and prepared food offerings useful to touring cyclists.

Hot food.detail: Deli page describes a hot case with rotisserie Maple Hill free-range chicken and made-from-scratch dinners, entrees, and soups
